meta.title: Why A Free Trial Wants Your Credit Card First
meta.hook: The most important moment in a free trial is the deadline you are expected to forget.
meta.description: Many free trials use negative-option billing: if you do not cancel before the trial ends, the company treats your silence as permission to begin charging. The FTC advises checking the deadline, price, and cancellation method before signing up.

scenes.narration: The most important moment in a free trial is the cancellation deadline the business expects you to remember.

visual.visual_intent: A subscription screen with a countdown timer
visual.decision_reason: FTC warns that missing the cancellation deadline usually triggers charges

scenes.narration: Many trials ask for a card upfront, then automatically convert into paid billing when the trial ends.

visual.visual_intent: A credit card entered into a free-trial signup form
visual.decision_reason: FTC explains why trials request payment information

scenes.narration: This is called a negative option: your silence is treated as permission to keep charging until you cancel.

visual.visual_intent: A clean loop diagram showing automatic monthly charges

scenes.narration: The signup is immediate, but the cost arrives days or weeks later, when the original decision is easy to forget.

visual.visual_intent: A small calendar reminder buried beneath notifications
visual.decision_reason: Explains the delayed conversion mechanism without a fabricated statistic

scenes.narration: The Federal Trade Commission says to check the deadline, post-trial price, and cancellation steps before entering payment details.

visual.visual_intent: Trial length, price, and cancel button highlighted
visual.decision_reason: FTC consumer guidance lists terms, length, price, and cancellation information

scenes.narration: Free describes the trial period, not the subscription. The business model begins when inaction turns into recurring revenue.

visual.visual_intent: Coins appearing repeatedly across calendar months
visual.decision_reason: Closing synthesis of the verified business mechanism
